anomalies.description: A black muscle car collides with a silver bus on a desert highway, causing the bus to lift, flip onto its side, and skid violently across the road and into the dirt shoulder, generating massive dust and debris.

A large bus (Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department vehicle) is involved in a high-speed rollover crash on a rural road, flipping multiple times and disintegrating while generating massive dust and debris.
A large bus (Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department vehicle) violently rolls over on a rural road, transitioning from upright to fully inverted while shedding debris and generating dust.
A sudden violent rupture/explosion occurs as the bus lies on its side, ejecting fragments and debris outward in a burst—visible as flying pieces and a flash of material at t=10.0–10.5s.
